description: This source file contains a C# program that creates a minimalistic PDF document using MigraDoc and PdfSharp libraries, demonstrating document creation, styling, adding images, and rendering to PDF.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Main class containing the entry point for creating and rendering a PDF document using MigraDoc.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Main method that sets up font resolver, creates a document, renders it to PDF, saves, and displays it.

methods.name: CreateDocument
methods.description: Creates a minimalistic PDF document with a paragraph, footer, and an image.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds an image to the last section of the document, setting its width.
